name: v274_news18_bee_largecap_fade
hypothesis: RavenPack's direct earnings evaluation score may capture a different transform of earnings news than the submitted earnings_evaluation_sentiment alpha; a slow large-cap fade tests whether analyst/news overreaction persists while strict correlation gate blocks near duplicates.
field_notes: Uses nws18_bee, not earnings_evaluation_sentiment or nws18_ber_fast_d1. Same robust vector-safe cap-gated template, with strict corr gate expected to reject duplicates.

name: v274_rp_ess_earnings_largecap_fade
hypothesis: Event sentiment score of earnings news is a lower-level event surface; fading smoothed large-cap earnings event sentiment may preserve the successful mechanism but with different PnL timing than the average earnings-evaluation field.
field_notes: Uses rp_ess_earnings, previously unused locally, and will be abandoned if it errors or correlates too highly to npg5egk8/qMAJGLQv.

name: v274_rp_css_earnings_largecap_fade
hypothesis: Composite sentiment score of earnings news may aggregate a different RavenPack scoring layer; this tests whether composite earnings sentiment gives an independent enough slow fade.
field_notes: This is closer to existing earnings news capacity and should only submit if correlation stays below the strict frontier gate.

name: v274_corporate_action_sentiment_largecap_fade
hypothesis: Corporate action announcement sentiment can be overinterpreted around buybacks, splits, and other actions; a cap-gated slow fade tests a broader corporate-action surface than the M&A-specific route, which was too weak alone.
field_notes: Uses corporate_action_sentiment, a low-alphaCount field distinct from merger_acquisition_sentiment.

name: v274_news18_acb_largecap_fade
hypothesis: The RavenPack ACB corporate-action announcement score is another corporate-action layer; fading it in liquid large caps may capture announcement overreaction without relying on earnings surfaces.
field_notes: Uses nws18_acb, not the M&A-specific field. This is a corporate-action surface probe.

name: v274_legal_event_sentiment_largecap_fade
hypothesis: Legal-news event sentiment may trigger short-run overreaction but mean-revert in large liquid names; it is economically distinct from earnings release/evaluation and could add lower-correlation capacity.
field_notes: Uses rp_ess_legal. This is a cautious single legal-news probe; do not expand if LSUS or correlation fails.
